At some point prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a '''Tusken Raider''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] mourned over the loss of a [[Death/Legends|dying]] [[Unidentified Tusken Raider (elder)|elder]] by [[Music/Legends|singing]] a melancholy, dreamy song. The scene was witnessed surreptitiously by the [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] [[Wenny Boggs]].
